title: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020
ministry: Ministry of Steel, Government of India

applicable_standards.product: High strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement
Hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel
Carbon steel cast billet ingots, billets, blooms and slabs for re-rolling
Mild steel and medium tensile steel bars and hard-drawn steel wire

msme_exemption_rules.micro_enterprises: No exemption from compliance; 6-month initial transition buffer expired. Testing subsidies under PTQAP available.
msme_exemption_rules.small_enterprises: Mandatory compliance; fast-track simplified inspection procedure applicable under BIS Guidelines.
msme_exemption_rules.medium_enterprises: Standard Scheme-I audit and conformity assessment mandatory.

penal_provisions: Section 29 of BIS Act, 2016 — Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine not less than ₹2,00,000 or up to 10 times value of goods.

title: Footwear made from Leather and other materials (Quality Control) Order, 2024
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

applicable_standards.product: Leather safety footwear having direct vulcanized rubber sole

msme_exemption_rules.micro_enterprises: Relaxation given up to 1st January 2025 with 80% concession on testing charges under BIS SME incentive scheme.
msme_exemption_rules.small_enterprises: Relaxation given up to 1st July 2024 with 50% concession on application fee.

penal_provisions: Seizure of non-certified stock at ports and retail outlets under Section 17 & 29 of BIS Act, 2016.

title: Potable Water Bottles (Quality Control) Order, 2023
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

applicable_standards.product: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water)

msme_exemption_rules.micro_enterprises: Extended implementation timeline by additional 6 months upon filing self-declaration on Manakonline.
msme_exemption_rules.small_enterprises: Extended implementation timeline by additional 3 months.

penal_provisions: Prohibition of manufacture, import, distribution, sale, or lease without ISI Standard Mark.

title: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

applicable_standards.product: Safety of Toys - Mechanical and physical properties
Safety of Toys - Migration of certain elements (Heavy metals)

scheme: Scheme-I (ISI Mark Certification for Domestic and Foreign Manufacturers - FMCS)

msme_exemption_rules.micro_enterprises: No exemption from safety clauses. Concession in certification fee provided.
msme_exemption_rules.small_enterprises: Cluster testing facilitation at BIS accredited private & government testing laboratories.

penal_provisions: Strict ban on uncertified import containers at Indian Customs ports.

title: Electrical Wires and Cables (Quality Control) Order, 2023
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

applicable_standards.product: PVC insulated cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V
Cross-linked polyethylene insulated PVC sheathed cables

msme_exemption_rules.micro_enterprises: Special 9-month extension provided for Micro units subject to submitting raw material test reports.
